failure_criteria.neighborhoods: Strategy uses the full 3x3 lookback/band grid at1000 for its asset; portfolio uses the full 3x3 lookback/BTC-weight grid. All 500/1500 component variants additionally reported and never hidden.

grid.ETH_weight: 1 minus BTC weight explicitly frozen; no normalization
grid.portfolios: same lookback for BTC and ETH, band=0.01; use independently reserved component at exactly 2000*raw_weight initial capital

plan.hypothesis: A symmetric SMA hysteresis band may reduce costly switching around the average; fixed BTC/ETH capital sleeves may diversify the resulting paths. This is a new extension, not a claim of replicating paper returns.

rules.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
rules.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
rules.portfolio: Weights specify fractions of initial 2000 USDT capital, not target weights later. Sum actual already-size-costed component NAVs on exactly identical timestamps; no second scaling, averaging Sharpe or new component backtests.
rules.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

sources.use: SMA trend and transaction-cost motivation; hysteresis is our own explicitly frozen extension
Official cached real public data and checksum provenance

walk_forward.fitting: No supervised labels, preprocessing or fitted parameters; rolling train boundaries are diagnostic, historical completed bars warm indicators; all parameters and weights fixed before OOS outcomes.
walk_forward.state: Start cash at first OOS decision; indicator warmup may use earlier completed prices. Maintain signal/positions/NAV through every fold. Liquidate only at the terminal boundary.

protocol_deviation.detail: An equal-capital hold comparator was newly combined and its metrics calculated from existing completed BTC/ETH1000 hold curves before its own registry reservation. The39 research configurations were all reserved before calculation; their outcomes and frozen gates remain unchanged. Preserve the first result/source snapshot, reserve this genuine new comparator now, retain all3 combined paths and finish it rejected as comparison-only. Never describe its first calculation as preregistered.
